content.text: Good - 26 frames extracted. Now I'll use GIMP to load them as layers and export as an animated GIF.

input.command:
cat > /tmp/make_gif.scm << 'EOF'
(let* ((files (cadr (file-glob "/tmp/gif_frames/frame*.png" 1)))
       (sorted-files (sort files (lambda (a b) (string<? a b))))
       (first-file (car sorted-files))
       (image (car (gimp-file-load RUN-NONINTERACTIVE first-file first-file))))
  ;; Add remaining frames as layers
  (for-each
    (lambda (f)
      (let* ((layer (car (gimp-file-load-layer RUN-NONINTERACTIVE image f))))
        (gimp-image-insert-layer image layer 0 0)
        (gimp-item-set-name layer (string-append (basename f ".png") " (200ms)"))))
    (cdr sorted-files))
  ;; Rename base layer with delay too
  (let ((base-layer (car (gimp-image-get-layer-by-name image (basename first-file ".png")))))
    (if (not (= base-layer -1))
        (gimp-item-set-name base-layer (string-append (basename first-file ".png") " (200ms)"))))
  ;; Convert to indexed for GIF
  (gimp-image-flatten image)
  ;; We need layers for animation, so reload approach:
  (gimp-image-delete image))

;; Real approach - build animation
(let* ((files (cadr (file-glob "/tmp/gif_frames/frame*.png" 1)))
       (sorted-files (sort files (lambda (a b) (string<? a b))))
       (first-file (car sorted-files))
       (image (car (gimp-file-load RUN-NONINTERACTIVE first-file first-file)))
       (base-layer (car (gimp-image-get-active-drawable image))))
  (gimp-item-set-name base-layer "frame-001 (200ms)")
  (for-each
    (lambda (f)
      (let* ((new-layer (car (gimp-file-load-layer RUN-NONINTERACTIVE image f))))
        (gimp-image-insert-layer image new-layer 0 0)
        (gimp-item-set-name new-layer (string-append "frame-" (number->string (length (gimp-image-get-layers image))) " (200ms)"))))
    (cdr sorted-files))
  (gimp-image-set-active-layer image base-layer)
  (gimp-image-convert-indexed image NO-DITHER MAKE-PALETTE 256 FALSE FALSE "")
  (file-gif-save RUN-NONINTERACTIVE image (car (gimp-image-get-active-drawable image))
                 "/home/user/Desktop/src_clip.gif" "src_clip"
                 0 1 0 2)
  (gimp-image-delete image))
(gimp-quit 0)
EOF

gimp -i -b - < /tmp/make_gif.scm 2>&1 | tail -20

FILES=$(ls /tmp/gif_frames/frame*.png | sort)

FILE_LIST=$(echo "$FILES" | awk '{printf "\"%s\" ", $0}')

cat > /tmp/make_gif.scm << EOF
(let* ((files (list $FILE_LIST))
       (first-file (car files))
       (image (car (gimp-file-load RUN-NONINTERACTIVE first-file first-file)))
       (base-layer (car (gimp-image-get-active-drawable image))))
  (gimp-item-set-name base-layer "frame-000 (200ms)")
  (let loop ((rest (cdr files)) (i 1))
    (if (not (null? rest))
        (let* ((f (car rest))

          (gimp-image-insert-layer image new-layer 0 0)
          (gimp-item-set-name new-layer (string-append "frame-" (number->string i) " (200ms)"))
          (loop (cdr rest) (+ i 1)))))

  (file-gif-save RUN-NONINTERACTIVE image (car (gimp-image-get-active-drawable image))
